name: tier-separable-tests
body: Tests are organized so each tier can be selected independently and the default gate stays fast. Unit and int tests live beside their module in a sibling `tests.rs` that preserves the module path, so libtest's `…::tests::unit::` and `…::tests::int::` filters keep selecting them; every e2e test lives outside the production module tree in its own crate's top-level `tests/` integration crate — "top-level" is per-crate, so a frontend crate's e2e tests live with that crate (e.g. `src/pylib/tests/`, `src/structlib/tests/`), never in the root crate's `tests/` — and carries the `#[ignore = "e2e tier: …; run via cargo test-e2e"]` marker. A plain `cargo test` runs unit+int only; `cargo test-e2e` runs the e2e tier. The four documented invocations keep selecting the tiers they name. The layout is chosen for cohesion and reuse — a module's tests sit beside the module, and shared fixtures have a single home — not to reduce any file's line count.
